copy.testFlightWhatToTest:
Mapvest — camera reliability fix, stock ratings, and smarter search

Please test on a real device:
• Camera: take a photo, review the result, retake, and take another — repeat 4-5 times in one session without leaving the tab. Every capture should work immediately with no "Camera still starting" message; previously this could get permanently stuck until the app was force-quit.
• Open a company's detail page from the map, a camera result, or search. Confirm a rating chip (Strong Buy / Buy / Hold / Sell / Strong Sell with a confidence percentage) appears at the top when there's enough signal, or a quiet "Not enough signal yet" state otherwise. Tap it to expand drivers and evidence sources, and confirm the "not investment advice" disclaimer is visible.
• Identify a public brand and a private/unlisted brand with Camera. Confirm the result card shows an investable verdict chip (for example "Investable via parent" or "Proxy exposure via ...") with a probability, and that Save is emphasized when it's a strong candidate.
• On Home, search a ticker (AAPL), a brand name (Nike), and a plain-English question ("is coffee a good short right now"). Confirm each routes correctly — ticker or brand to the detail page, a question toward Research — and that a brief intent hint appears while typing.
• Confirm none of the above ever blocks or crashes when offline or when a rating, verdict, or search call fails — the app should just fall back to its prior behavior (chip simply absent, default routing).

Finance information is sourced research, not advice.
Feedback: jawaun@generalintelligencecompany.com
copy.betaReviewNotes: Mapvest helps people discover publicly traded companies and sourced public comparables for private brands through a map, camera, and research experience, alongside a lightweight collection layer: Weekly Quests, a Leaderboard ranked on who identifies a company early (never on raw scan volume), a permanent per-company "first capture" credit with a community photo gallery, and a shared map-tile objective testers can complete together. It provides informational market research; it does not execute trades, connect to brokerage accounts in this release, manage portfolios, or provide personalized investment advice. Follow the reviewer walkthrough for sign-in, the live quickstart, AI-sharing consent, widget setup, one opt-in notification, and disposable-account deletion.
copy.appStoreWhatsNew:
New this release: a rating at the top of every company page — Strong Buy through Strong Sell with a confidence score, key drivers, and sourced evidence, so you get a quick read before you dig in.

Camera scans now tell you how investable what you found actually is — direct, through a parent company, or via a sector proxy — right on the result card.

Search got smarter: type a ticker, a brand, or a plain question, and Mapvest routes you to the right place automatically.

Also includes a camera reliability fix so repeated captures no longer require reopening the app.
copy.appReviewNotes: Use the secure demo-account delivery configured in the protected release environment. Start on Map, inspect a nearby company, and sign in when saving. Complete the live quickstart with a second Camera or photo-library company and accept the editable Research prompt. AI sharing is disclosed before Camera and Research transfers. On Home, open the Weekly Quests card and the Leaderboard it links to; your own row appears even at zero score. Identify any brand with a live camera capture to see it added to that company's photo gallery on its detail page — only a live camera capture may ever be submitted there, never a photo-library pick. Add the Nearby Quest widget from the Home Screen. Enable a notification category in Settings, use the deterministic protected trigger, and confirm the alert highlights the intended Map company. Test permanent deletion only with the separate disposable account. See the fallback fields in this manifest if live location or Camera is unavailable. Mapvest is sourced informational research, not investment advice or trade execution.

reviewerWalkthrough.signIn: Open the profile drawer, choose Sign in, and use the protected review mailbox or demo-code delivery described in App Store Connect review credentials.
reviewerWalkthrough.sampleMapArea: Use Midtown Manhattan around Bryant Park if current location is sparse; select that map area and refresh nearby results.
reviewerWalkthrough.cameraSubject: Use a clearly labeled Coca-Cola product or the protected review photo fixture; expect KO with cited sources.
reviewerWalkthrough.notificationTrigger: Enable Nearby Discovery in Settings, then use the protected reviewer trigger documented in App Store Connect; allow the documented delivery delay and tap View on Map.
reviewerWalkthrough.deletionAccount: Use only the separate disposable review account, reauthenticate, type the destructive confirmation, and inspect operation status if the request is interrupted.
reviewerWalkthrough.fallback: If location is unavailable, use the selected map area. If Camera is unavailable, choose the protected review photo from the photo library. Contact support if a provider is unavailable.
